purpose: Remove visible hand/arm pixels and reconstruct a plausible document/background counterfactual as though the human limb were absent.

poc_population.selection_rule: deterministic balanced allocation across non-empty strata, then stable SHA256 order within stratum

mask_scope.extension: deterministic skin-connected and wrist-to-boundary forearm extension

candidate_inpainting_methods.role: preferred naturalistic candidate if reproducibly runnable

poc_quality_gate.outside_mask_change: must be negligible except a narrow feather/seam ring
poc_quality_gate.visual_review: all 100 PoC images, blinded to classifier output

full_scale_rule: Proceed to frozen-model evaluation only if at least one inpainting method passes the PoC quality gate. Otherwise report PoC failure and stop.
interpretation_limit: A performance change is evidence about sensitivity to the frozen hand/arm-removal counterfactual, not proof of causality or perfect reconstruction.
